en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly town with numerous villas and small houses scattered among trees and vineyards. On a prominent hill to the right stands a large, castle‑like mansion with turrets and steep roofs, overlooking winding roads and terraced slopes. In the far distance lies a broad valley with fields and a river plain. The general style suggests a central European spa or hillside suburb; there is no printed or handwritten text visible on the image.
